ownedFacts: Village identity, owner, creation time, position, resource trait, level and connected realm.
Whether the one-time starting army has been granted.
Production-pass ownership and consumption for this game.
Immutable starting resources, army delay and resource-selection weights.
requiredConfig: Settling start, main start, end, development flag and recorded execution context.
The existing settlement geometry and shared reservations, with one structure per village allocation.
Village-pass entitlement from the configured ledger operator, except development entry.
The original 22-resource choice pool and its unchanged weights.
Village starting resources, troop delay, biome starting troops, Labor production and capacity.
newBehaviourGates: Each production pass creates exactly one village in Single, Triple and Duel games.
Village placement never consumes realm-entry capacity or blocks a later realm entry.
Realms and villages share reservations and cannot overlap, including interleaved entries.
The planner chooses the tile independently of connected_realm_entity_id.
No village slots, directions or per-realm count limit exist in the native path.
Repeated consumption of a village pass rejects; a failed placement leaves its pass available.
Development entry skips both pass and ledger and permits more than six villages per realm.
Exhausted geometry produces an explicit terminal rejection for the accepted ticket.
Realm and village creation reveal only their own tile, with no exploration lottery or points.
parityRequirements: The same root selects the same village resource from the original complete weighted pool.
At the same position and recorded time, starting resources, Labor production and capacity match.
Army grant requires the owner, a village, an active main game, the configured delay and an unclaimed grant.
Army grant chooses the same troops and amounts for the same biome and configuration.
A rejected action preserves gameplay facts while its accepted ticket records the terminal result.
Packed structure storage preserves observable facts at field boundaries and through ownership, upgrades and roster mutations.
normalization: Entity and account identities map bijectively; recorded time is supplied as oracle block time.
Planner placement, pass consumption, removal of slots and the reveal rule are the ruled new behaviour, not oracle parity targets.
Army eligibility is the existing Structure starting-troops flag; no second claimed row is stored.

required: Enter a realm, settle a village through the planner and claim its army after the delay through Herald.

reductions: Remove village count and slot state; settlement passes bound production village count.
Store structure base fields in one packed slot instead of ten independent slots, preserving their ranges.
Store each guard's eight boost fields in one packed slot, shared with explorer troop storage.
Reuse structure ownership, resource facts and the one-time troop-grant flag.
Remove the duplicate stored and projected structure category; the base owns it.
Derive structure existence from its nonzero category instead of a second map.
Pack troop count, stamina, boosts and combat flags into four slots with unchanged field ranges.
Separate settlement allocation and entitlement from ordered execution; share one typed internal settlement-creation command.

ruledDivergences.oracle: Direction consumes one of six realm slots.
ruledDivergences.native: One village per production pass through the single-structure planner pool, without realm entry consumption.
ruledDivergences.projection: The oracle connection is placed two hexes west of the native planner-selected tile. Native planner inputs and pool remain unchanged. The same position lets grants, production, biome and army outcomes remain paired.

ruledDivergences.native: The existing Structure flag records the single grant.
ruledDivergences.projection: The oracle fact projection reads VillageTroop.claimed for a village; it does not mutate oracle storage.

admission.rule: The signed owner must match PlayerRegistry at acceptance; the retained owner is used unchanged at execution.
admission.deployment: The patched node must be rebuilt with the matching native schema before the fresh rehearsal.
